Checkout.note: Ask controller to identify the acquirer and country-specific escalation contact. A pay_ ID alone does not identify the acquirer.

Tap.note: Confirm escalation ownership; these are documented Tap contacts.

TapAcquirer.note: Acquirer workflow; never route a Checkout pay_ payment into a second automatic refund queue.

Switch.note: HyperPay and Switch use the same internal recipients per operator instruction. External contacts are escalation options; confirm before addressing.

QPay.note: More than 90 days: acquiring-bank escalation, not a routine TESS refund request. Ask controller for the bank contact.

Knet.note: Manual refund requests must be sent through authorized Kuwait Finance POCs Abedalqader Issa or Murad Kunhamed. Subject: Merchant Refund Request. Do not collect card details in this tool.

Deema.note: Controller must provide the contact and approved bulk format.

Unknown.note: Controller review required; do not guess the PSP.
